text:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 decode latency breach for streaming endpoints in us-west-2 > 2.5s (SLO: 1.2s). affected routes: /v1/stream, /v1/chat/stream. linked alert: https://monitoring.redwood.example/alerts/ALERT-1738204567 :rotating_light:

Alyssa: seeing it in dashboards too, p95 up ~800ms, p99 spike to ~3s. streaming stalls reported (clients see partial chunks then long gap).

Ben: confirmed, spike starts ~1738201200 and correlated with kernel build rollout (kernel-5.18.14-trt9) that hit canaries at ~1738199000.

Chandra: also rolling out flashattn v2.3 on the same build. suspect compilepath change + new flashattn kernels.

Ryan (oncall): handoff: I'm on pager. prioritizing impact assessment and mitigation. customers with dedicated pools flagged? Kyra: yes — two enterprise tenants on dedicated pools (acct-ACME, acct-Bluebird) saw increased session disconnects. Kyra uploaded a short impact spreadsheet: https://docs.internal/impact/1738204567

Alyssa: quick checks: traces show long stalls inside decode loop on GPU kernels, stack traces point to flashattn kernel launches waiting on page faults (nvml shows device memory fragmentation).

Ben: ran a microbench on canary image (same kernel/build) locally — reproduced high tail when sequence length > 2048 and streaming enabled.

Chandra: can we route streaming traffic to older kernel pool? current routing policy allows fallback to compat-pool-1 (kernel-5.16).

Ryan (oncall): action plan: 1) Reroute traffic off canaries to compat-pool-1, 2) pin dedicated pools for impacted tenants to previous kernel, 3) disable flashattn optimized path for streaming models as quick mitigation.

Alyssa: I'm going to flip the runtime flag to disable flash path for streaming: ``/etc/redwood/runtime.conf: use_flashattn_for_streaming=false``. rolling this as a live config change.

Chandra: i'll prepare a rollback of kernel on canaries if traffic reroute doesn't bring p99 down within 10m.

deploy-bot: @channel rolling config change use_flashattn_for_streaming=false to runtime-config/service-prod (change id cfg-8842). Started.

Ben: prometheus query I used: ``histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(decode_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))`` shows p99 for /v1/stream went from 0.9s -> 3.1s at 1738201300.

Ryan (oncall): Kyra, please start pinned rollback for acct-ACME pool. command:
```
rbctl pin --tenant acct-ACME --kernel kernel-5.16.9 --reason "mitigate p99 streaming stalls"
```

Kyra (ops): running pin now, will report when done.

Kyra (ops): pin complete for acct-ACME at 1738205120.

Alyssa: runtime config change is live. seeing immediate drop in new-error streaming stalls on ingress (logs show fewer stalled chunk callbacks). p95 down to ~350ms, p99 trending down to ~1.1s.

Ben: nice. metrics look much better on routed traffic to compat-pool-1. old kernel handles prefix caching differently which avoids the paging behavior.

Chandra: still seeing some in-flight sessions on canary nodes — we should cordon and drain canary hosts to avoid more clients hitting patched kernel.

Ryan (oncall): agreed. Kyra, can you drain the canary nodeset: ``k8s-scale canary-nodeset --replicas 0 --graceful``

Kyra (ops): drain requested, starting now.

deploy-bot: cordon/drain job started (job id drain-1738206001).

Alyssa: for longer term: reproduce with a focused microbench (sequence length sweep + streaming), check cudnn/driver interactions, and run FlashAttention's mem-util traces. suspect a kernel memory allocator regression combined with flashattn kernel launch pattern.

Chandra: opened an internal PR to revert the compile flag change that enabled aggressive kernel fusion in trt build: PR #8123. Also adding a compiler flag toggle: ``--trt-fusion=false`` for next canary.

Ben: we should also add a canary smoke that runs a high-seq streaming path in CI for any kernel or trt changes.

Ryan (oncall): customer comms: Kyra, coordinate with CS to notify acct-ACME and acct-Bluebird that we experienced tail latency and streaming stalls tied to a kernel rollout; mitigation done (pin + config change). We need to offer postmortem and possible credits.

Kyra (ops): ack — pinging CS: @cs-team, creating support tickets and drafting message.

Alyssa: quick telemetry snippets for postmortem: attach p95/p99 graphs (link), sample flame trace (link), and the microbench script used.

Ben: microbench snippet (attached to thread):
```
python tools/bench_stream_decode.py --model redwood-xl --seq-lens 512,1024,2048,4096 --iters 100 --stream
```
repro on canary builds shows tail at 2048+.

Chandra: initial RCA hypothesis: aggressive TRT fusion + flashattn kernel variant introduced a memory access pattern that increases pagefaults under high-concurrency streaming; combined with kernel-5.18's memory allocator changes => paging stalls.

Ryan (oncall): current status: mitigation applied (runtime flag + pinned rollbacks + drain). p95 returned near normal, p99 reduced to ~1.05s across route; open actions: full kernel rollback on cluster if any residuals, full postmortem, add CI smoke, revert compile flag in trt build, and a follow-up to test driver/kernel combinations.

Alyssa: logging follow-ups: capture nvtx traces for next two hours and keep canary drained until we validate fix in staging.

Chandra: PR #8123 has a hold request for kernel rollforward until we validate.

Kyra (ops): CS notif drafts ready, tickets created: TKT-9876 (acct-ACME), TKT-9877 (acct-Bluebird).

Ryan (oncall): handing off to next oncall (Ben) for overnight watch. Ben, please monitor p99 for next 4 hours and keep the canary drained.

Ben: taking over. setting scheduled check-ins every 30m and watch alert.

incident-bot: INCIDENT HANDOFF: 1738204567 -> 1738209000 (Ben). summary: kernel/trt/flashattn rollout caused p99 streaming tail spikes; mitigated by runtime flag + pool pin + node drain.

Alyssa: adding note to ticket: temp mitigation may degrade throughput slightly for very long sequences due to fallback path, but preferable to stalls.

Chandra: adding to postmortem checklist: reproduce in perf lab, validate driver versions (nvidia-driver 545.x vs 550.x), test flashattn variants, add canary smoke.

Ben: will keep thread updated with any regressions. if p99 creeps >1.5s reopen immediate pager. :thumbsup:

(End of thread)
